notes: Previously studied LendingClub/BikeSharing pools: repeated splits, not pristine external validation.
Shared flow alpha/steps selected by mean validation full SW of hard and direct+reconstruction, averaged over selection seeds.
TabSyn uses upstream model components, quantile normalization, width1024 and schedulers; capped validation early-stopping adapter, not an exact official-recipe reproduction.
TabSyn validation checkpoint selection occurs per run. Budget caps are fixed before final test access; cap-limited runs are explicitly flagged.
No test-driven budget expansion. Seed variation within each split and variation between overlapping random splits are reported separately.
Timing is synchronized but may include other desktop GPU activity; no exclusive-device speed claim.
